title: Folseek protein usage: clustering and similarity search

chains.description: List of chains, separated by comma, to be used for clustering and similarity search

query_pdb.description: Input PDB folder (ending with /) or .txt file containing multiple PDB paths (one per line)

target_pdb.description: Input PDB folder (ending with /) or .txt file containing multiple PDB paths (one per line) to be used as target database for similarity search (default: same as query_pdb_dir)

foldseek_exhaustive_search.description: Foldseek: Skips prefilter and performs an all-vs-all alignment (more sensitive but much slower) (default: false)

foldseek_e.description: Foldseek: List matches below this E-value (range 0.0-inf, default: 10); increasing it reports more distant structures

foldseek_alignment_type.description: Foldseek: Alignment to use; 0: 3Di Gotoh-Smith-Waterman (local, not recommended), 1: TMalign (global, slow), 2: 3Di+AA Gotoh-Smith-Waterman (local, default)

foldseek_embedding_metric.description: Foldseek easy-search output metric to use for computing similarity matrix for UMAP embedding (qtmscore, alntmscore, fident, ...)

foldseek_c.description: Foldseek: List matches above this fraction of aligned (covered) residues (see --cov-mode) (default: 0.0); higher coverage = more global alignment

foldseek_tmscore_threshold.description: Foldseek: TM-score threshold for accepting alignments

foldseek_min_seq_id.description: Minimum sequence identity for alignments to be clustered (default: 0.0)

foldseek_s.description: Foldseek: Adjust sensitivity to speed trade-off; lower is faster, higher more sensitive (fast: 7.5, default: 9.5)

n_neighbors.description: List of numbers specifying the neighbors to use for computation of UMAP; the larger the number the more global structure is preserved

workflow_name.description: Name of the clustering workflow to run
